messages:
Ravi: Heads up — spotted weird oscillation in the eviction rate metric during the 12h long-context soak. looks like periodic spikes every ~30m, but KV residency doesn't change much. wondering if this is noise or double-counting from sampler.
Sophia: oof. can you paste the prometheus query and a screenshot? :eyes:
Ravi: sure — query I ran:
```
sum by(pool) (rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
```
and the residency gauge we look at:
`avg_over_time(kv_residency_ratio[30m])`
Ravi: screenshot -> https://redwood.s3/soak/eviction-spikes-12h.png
Liam: quick thought — sampler increments may be batched, so `kv_evictions_total` could be reporting bursts when sampler flushes. are we summing across shards? that could amplify spikes.
Sophia: good call. are we sure eviction is an atomic counter per-evict event and not per-page-scan? previous code had per-frag increments.
Ravi: looking through runtime logs, I see lines like:
```
INFO kv: evicting frag=0x12 count=8 pool=gpu-0
```
so when a compaction runs it emits one line with count>1. prometheus exporter increments `kv_evictions_total` by that count, which is correct, but the sampling agent emits metrics every 5m in bursts.
perf-bot: CI perf-run finished: long-context-soak (#487) — baseline vs current shows +0.8% mem growth and +2.4% 95th latency in tail windows around the spike periods.
Liam: that matches: bursts cause short-lived pressure and small GC/compaction activity that nudges latency.
Sophia: for dashboarding we should visualize both the raw counter rate and a per-second average smoothed by `increase(kv_evictions_total[30m]) / 1800` so the noise is visible but not overwhelming.
Ravi: +1. also want a panel for `kv_residency_ratio` with 1m and 30m rolling averages overlayed. helps check whether spikes actually reduce residency.
Liam: another thing — eviction counter cardinality: join by `pool, shard` to see if a single shard is noisy or cluster-wide. try:
```
sum by(pool, shard) (rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
```
and a heatmap across shards.
Sophia: let's add an event annotation for when compaction runs (we emit `kv_compaction_start` now). that will make causality obvious.
Ravi: action items: (1) add smoothed eviction panel and heatmap by shard, (2) overlay compaction events, (3) change sampler flush to jittered intervals to avoid synchronized bursts (Liam to prototype), (4) follow up with perf-run after change.
Liam: I'll experiment with jittered flush and also add a prom scrape debug endpoint to see exporter emit timings.
perf-bot: noted — scheduling a new soak perf-run after changes, tag #perf-run-eviction-sanity.
Sophia: thanks. small follow-up: we should ensure alerting doesn't fire on expected micro-bursts. propose threshold on 5m rate but require `for: 10m` and check `kv_residency_ratio < 0.6` as an extra condition.
Ravi: agreed. I'll draft the dashboard panels and the pager suppression rule and drop them in the dashboards repo. ping me if you want review. :thumbsup:
Sophia: cheers — feel free to @me when dashboard PRs are up.
Liam: will PR sampler jitter and exporter debug logs later today.
Ravi: filing a short runbook note in #eng-runtime-wiki describing how to interpret eviction spike patterns and which panels to check. linking here after done.
Ravi: runbook link -> https://docs.redwood/eng-runtime/kv-eviction-signals
